paite: Aw tangte na ma a aluankhiak zoizoina ding un, van botkek in hong kumsuk teitei lechin aw.
heading: TOUPA Zion
english: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—

paite: Namte na ma a alinna ding un nang hon doute kiang a na min theihsakna ding in, mei in sing nen akuansak a, mei in tui asousak bang in!
english: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

paite: Ka lamet louh uh thil mulkimhuai na hih lai in na hong suk a, na ma ah tangte aluangkhe zoizoi uhi.
english: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

paite: Nidanglai a kipan in mite'n, nang kia lou ngal, amaute ngak ding a, sepsak zelpa Pathian athei ngei kei ua, bil in lah aza ngei kei ua, mit in leng amu ngei sam kei uhi.
english: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

paite: Nang zaw, nuamtak a om a diktattak a hihmi, na lampite a nang hon theigigete, na don a; ngai in, nang na heh a, kou thil ka hihkhial ua; huaite ah sawtpi ka omta ua, huchi in hotdam in ka om thei lai ding uam?
english: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

paite: Minin bang in ka na om vekta ngal ua, ka diktatna teng uh leng puansilh nin bang ahi; ka vek un nah bang in ka vuai ua; ka thulimlouhnate un huih bang in ahon mutmang zel hi.
english: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

paite: Huchi in na min lou a, nang hon len ding a kihihhalh kuamah a-om kei uh; kou a kipan in na mai na selta ngal a, ka thulimlouhnate uh zang in na hon mangsakta hi.
english: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

paite: Tu in zaw, aw TOUPA, nang ka pa uh na hi; kou bellei ka hi ua; nang kou hon velpa na hi; huchi in ka vek un na khutsuak ka hi uh.
english: But now, Yahweh, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

paite: TOUPA aw, heh ke'nla, thulimlouhnate leng tangtawn in theigige ke'n; ngai in hehpih in hon en inla, ka vek un nangmah mite ka hi uhi.
english: Don’t be furious, Yahweh. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

paite: Na khopi siangthoute gamdai ahong suak ua, Zion gamdai ahong suak a, Jerusalem mun nutsiat ahong hita hi.
english: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

paite: Ka inn siangthou uleh ka inn kilawmtak uh, ka pipute un nang a hon phat zelna uh, mei ahal ahi; ka thil deihhuaite tengteng uh lah hihsiat in a-omvekta ngal a.
english: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

paite: TOUPA aw, huai thilte ah na kidek thei ding a hia? Na dai nilouh in na hon hihgenthei nilouh ding a hia?
english: Will you hold yourself back for these things, Yahweh? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?
